{{Quote|All troop carriers will assemble at the north entrance.|[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Episode V" />}}
The '''Rebel Troop Cart''', also known as '''Rebel Troop Carrier''' or '''flight crew shuttle''', was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle used by the Alliance to carry [[Rebel trooper/Legends|troops]] into battle. Each transport could carry up to six [[Human/Legends|human]]-sized individuals. In addition these vehicles were used for transporting personnel within Rebel bases.<ref name="Episode V" /><ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

During the evacuation of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Rebel transport ships were loaded using these troop carriers.<ref name="Episode V" /> A personnel carrier of this model brought the Rebel strike force to the captured [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']] inside the main hangar of [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']], prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Rebel_Troop_Carrier-publicity-photo.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rebels on a Troop Carrier]]
This vehicle was briefly seen on film at Echo Base in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] and on ''Home One'' in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']], mostly in the background. Its most prominent appearance comes from a publicity photo for the earlier movie featuring the lead Rebel characters in and around the vehicle.<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=news/the-rebel-troop-carrier-from-echo-base-to-rancho-obi-wan|text=The Rebel Troop Carrier, from Echo Base to Rancho Obi-Wan}}</ref>
